rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.3, fd_recon_eta=0.1, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-9: DC-off breast-prior. Back to steps=8 (iter-8 steps=16 gave NO PSNR gain, 28.3 vs 28.5, 2x slower => NFE saturated at 8). Fine-tune the DOMINANT lever init_t. ONE KNOB init_t 0.4->0.3 (eta=0.1, steps=8). PRIOR coarse init_t sweep: 0.7->19.0, 0.4->24.6(eta1.0)/best-region, 0.2->24.2 - optimum bracketed near 0.3-0.4. HYPOTHESIS: init_t=0.3 (between the 0.2 and 0.4 coarse points, at the now-tuned low eta=0.1) may edge past the 0.4/eta0.1 PSNR (~28.5) by injecting slightly less noise while retaining enough flow-time for the prior to denoise. Fine-grid refinement of the init_t peak.
